You are a RUNNER for one billed Jev probe in freytag-forge. Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. It sends 180 small classifier requests (6 frozen drain cases x 3 question arms J0/J1/J2 x 10 samples) through the project's Cloudflare Worker /jev route; the ceiling is about $0.004 and the human approved it on 2026-10-29. A first attempt was cut off at 92 of 180 requests because the shell command ended while the probe was still running, so this run launches the probe DETACHED and waits for it. HARD RULES: run COMMAND 1 EXACTLY ONCE (then only poll with COMMAND 1b). NEVER run it a second time for any reason (not after an error, not after a partial result: a rerun would spend money again). Do not edit any file. Do not print, echo, cat or log environment variables or the .env file or any credential. Do not git commit.

COMMAND 1 (launches the billed run detached; it returns at once; a non-zero exit of the probe with partial rows is a valid outcome, do not retry):
cd /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge && export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp && (set -a; . ./.env; set +a; unset OPENAI_API_KEY RAILWAY_TOKEN RAILWAY_PROJECT_ID FREYTAG_TEST_CLOCK_TOKEN; setsid nohup .venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/environment_narration/drain_question_probe.py --run --confirm --samples 10 --max-calls 180 --max-usd 0.01 --out bench/results/environment-narration/drain-probe-rows.json > /tmp/drain-probe-run.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & echo $! > /tmp/drain-probe.pid)

COMMAND 1b (poll; repeat it, one call at a time, until it prints DONE; each call waits at most 40 seconds; do NOT run COMMAND 1 again):
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do if kill -0 $(cat /tmp/drain-probe.pid) 2>/dev/null; then sleep 5; else echo DONE; break; fi; done; echo still-running-or-done; tail -c 300 /tmp/drain-probe-run.log

COMMAND 2 (renders the report; it exits 1 when no arm passes the gate, which is a valid outcome; safe to rerun if it fails to render):
cd /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge && export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp && .venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/environment_narration/drain_question_probe.py --report --rows bench/results/environment-narration/drain-probe-rows.json --out bench/results/environment-narration/drain-probe-report.md

Run COMMAND 2 only after COMMAND 1b printed DONE. Then print the report's GATE section and say in one or two sentences what happened, including any stop reason. Do not interpret quality.
